title: Integrate release and smoke inventory coverage
summary: Integrates the lifecycle-reconciliation, Queue-to-Completed, and Settings field-matrix browser workflows into release selection, generated maps, active inventories, mutation-boundary documentation, and package validation evidence. It also keeps personal-mirror documentation executable and gives short-lived package children a bounded shutdown grace before declaring a leak.
reason: New focused smokes are not release evidence until canonical wrappers, the release gate, machine-readable maps, active operator/testing docs, prerequisite semantics, and package contents agree. Package acceptance must also distinguish a transient shutdown race from a persistent child-process leak without weakening the leak gate.
behavior_before: Shared smoke inventories and release selection did not include all newly added lifecycle, Queue, and Settings workflows; browser prerequisite skips could be described as successful wrapper exits; blanket non-mutation language did not identify each permitted disposable-root write; the private-mirror inventory combined mutually rejected Zip and KeepPersonalConfig flags; and package acceptance sampled child processes immediately after close.
behavior_after: The repository records 36 canonical smoke wrappers, including 24 browser wrappers backed by 26 browser Python modules. Active runbooks list the complete lifecycle/Queue/Settings/Library Profiles/Prose/Visual coverage, canonical wrappers fail prerequisite skips unless AllowSkippedTests is explicit, release selection includes the promoted workflows, mutation claims distinguish exact disposable-root writes from forbidden operator/live access, personal mirrors are documented as directory-only, and package acceptance waits up to 10 seconds for short-lived tracked children while still failing persistent PIDs.
manual_validation: GREEN: generated smoke-wrapper map reports 36 wrappers, 24 browser wrappers, and all 24 release-selected browser wrappers.
GREEN: smoke-wrapper map generator/check completed after the new lifecycle, Queue, and Settings wrappers were registered.
GREEN: active inventory recount confirmed 24 canonical browser wrappers and 26 browser Python modules; metrics-degraded-state and Settings builder-flush are direct-only modules.
GREEN: documentation checks confirmed browser discovery uses tests\webview and the individual Rename unittest selector names WebViewBrowserRenameSmoke.

RED: release-package review found the documented -Zip -KeepPersonalConfig private-mirror command is rejected by build.ps1; the inventory now documents directory-only personal mirrors and the release policy check guards the forbidden combination.
GREEN: Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 passed after adding the executable documentation assertion.

RED: deployable package verification reproduced a post-close race: production-surface audit, packaged Tauri launch/close, and bundle immutability passed, but three newly observed tracked PIDs were reported before they finished exiting; all three were absent at the first identity check.
GREEN: the focused package-acceptance scaffold tests passed (2 tests), and a real short-lived bundled-pwsh probe was cleared by the 10-second grace helper in 1299 ms.

GREEN: isolated source-tree release test passed with -RequireTests in 307 seconds; all Python, generated/tooling, environment, Tauri preview, reliability, tool-integration, and end-to-end gates passed.
GREEN: disposable test-inclusive handoff build verified 19,683 files and produced a 623,870,972-byte ZIP; its copied-bundle release test passed.
GREEN: disposable deployable build verified 18,565 files and produced a 622,728,648-byte ZIP with deployable=true, tests_included=false, and personal_config_included=false.

GREEN: both the deployable directory and freshly extracted ZIP passed production-surface audit, packaged Tauri launch/close, bundle immutability, runtime-root creation, and zero leaked tracked processes.
GREEN: AI guardrail postflight passed across summaries, maps, schemas, active-doc references, dependency, architecture, naming, and risky-file checks.
GREEN: strict change validation passed for 1068 unreleased packets with zero uncovered changed files.
GREEN: git diff --check passed and the binary NUL scan passed for all 312 changed or untracked paths.
rollback_plan: Revert the release-list registrations, regenerated aggregate maps, shared smoke inventories/runbooks, mutation matrix, and package evidence updates together. Do not remove the focused behavior packets or their wrappers unless those changes are also rolled back.
notes: This packet coordinates shared/release/generated evidence and does not add media policy. Browser validation is authorized only against generated disposable roots. A skipped prerequisite is never a pass; AllowSkippedTests is an explicit non-gating exception. No real-media validation is required for this release/inventory work. Source, handoff-package, deployable-directory, extracted-ZIP, and postflight gates are complete.
